programmes.d: In his first outing as a Reserve Officer, Buzz finds a dead body in a hotel room, threatening, among other things, Flynn and Provenza's plans to take the squad to a baseball game.
As the Major Crimes unit investigates a complicated gangland shooting, Detective Amy Sykes finds she must protect the identity of a witness capable of identifying the killer.
The squad tries to identify a possible murder victim from his skeletal remains, only to find he may have a criminal past of his own. A new friend helps Rusty with the Alice case.
After a shooting leaves two LA police officers dead, Major Crimes must work with Deputy Chief Fritz Howard (JON TENNEY) of the Special Operations Bureau to piece together the case.

A marine goes missing after a date with a reporter. During the investigation, the team discovers that three former members of his unit are dead and suspect the unit commander to be a serial killer. (TV-PG)
When a body of a murdered marine is found in the forest, the investigation leads to the local militia and a weapon deal gone wrong. (TV-PG)
Gibbs and his team investigate the death of a SEAL that occurred during a training exercise.(TV-PG)
The terrorist who previously held a part of the NCIS team hostage, returns with a plan to attack the President. (TV-PG)
When the wife and 9-year-old blind daughter of a Navy captain are kidnapped, Gibbs and his team are faced with a unique challenge. (TV-PG)

The NCIS team is called in to investigate when a perfectly functioning Marine helicopter is found in the middle of a crop circle. (TV-PG)
The NCIS team is called in to investigate when a body dressed as a Navy lieutenant is discovered apparently raped and murdered. (TV-PG)
A body found on a Marine firing range leads the team to discover a Mafia dumping ground. (TV-PG)
The NCIS team protects an Iraqi War veteran who is the target of terrorist threats. (TV-PG)
Gibbs and his team must clear the name of an elderly Marine who confesses to murdering his best friend nearly 60 years ago. (TV-PG)
Gibbs and his team are summoned to examine the mysterious death of a Navy commander who, after successful open heart surgery, seemingly bursts into flames. (TV-PG)
New information prompts the re-opening of an old investigation, forcing Captain Raydor and her Major Crimes division into partnership with a potentially corrupt FBI agent.

Major Crimes must decide whether a victim was targeted or a potential suicide. Rusty asks Sharon for help as he finally finds Alice Herrera's brother.
After Major Crimes identifies a murder victim as the son of a judge known for being tough on criminals (PATRICIA WETTIG), the squad hunts through her current case load.
Four wealthy one-percenters are left for dead outside a hospital emergency room in a twisty murder case that leads through an impossible list of suspects.
Sharon's ex, Jack (TOM BERENGER), is back again, defending a man who is attempting to withdraw a confession in the murder of his wife. Rusty interviews Slider (GARRETT COFFEY).
A murder during the taping of a reality competition show pitting married couples against each other has a profound effect on Sanchez, bringing back memories of his late wife.
The team investigates a follow-up attack on a victim of road rage. As Thanksgiving approaches, Flynn suffers a setback. Rusty gets the interview with Slider (GARRETT COFFEY).
Sharon and team investigate the murder of a young man who could afford a high-end apartment without visible means of support. Flynn endures an overly cheerful physical therapist.
The team investigates a fugitive diamond thief's murder. Rusty is in a tough spot when Mariana's brother Gus (RENE ROSADO) discovers his relationship with Slider (GARRETT COFFEY).
